title: Reports
description: How the Reports Center buckets and counts activity. Changes apply to all report tabs (Sources, Calling, Funnel, Follow-ups, Counsellors).

timezone.label: Report timezone
timezone.hint: All daily and hourly report bucketing uses this timezone.

connectedStatuses.label: Connected call statuses

interestedStatuses.label: Interested statuses
interestedStatuses.hint: Lead statuses that count as "interested" in source and funnel reports. Default: Interested.

toasts.connectedRequired: Pick at least one connected call status
toasts.interestedRequired: Pick at least one interested status
